shared_cause: The profile form can complete through a successful 200 JSON response as well as a 302 redirect. The current network evaluator expects only 302, so a completed mutation without that redirect is rejected.
correction_boundary: An alternative must match the same POST route and submitted website URL and require the exact successful JSON message. A generic 200 response or request dispatch alone is insufficient.
verdict_policy: Keep the second cohort's original score of zero. Any corrected score must be a separately bound scoring revision using the unchanged HAR and paired positive/negative controls.
